content:
sarah-nguyen: p95 latency spike on prod-rt-1 starting ~15:04 UTC, throughput steady but tail latency up to 1.2s. Kernel selector rolled to cuda-optim-v2 at 15:00. KV cache evictions jumped.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: 'runtime-latency-spike' (sev2). Incident lead: eng-runtime-oncall. Channel: #eng-runtime.

mike-chen: grabbing flameprof + perf traces. can someone confirm which models hit the new kernel?

leah-ops: looks like models/longctx-13b and rerank-xx are the top p90 callers. noisy tenant id: tenant-42 has burst.

dan-ramirez: attaching quick cpu/gpu stats: `GPU0 util 87%`, `mem alloc growth +8GB` over 3m. KV cache eviction rate 350/s. kernel switch caused different eviction pattern.

sarah-nguyen: suggested mitigations: 1) temporary request throttling on tenant-42; 2) flip kernel autoswitch off for prod-rt-1; 3) fallback routing to cpu-quant model for short seqs. which do we want first?

mike-chen: I'm for throttling tenant-42 first. runbook: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/throttle -d '{"tenant":"tenant-42","rate":20}'`

leah-ops: doing that now.

leah-ops: DONE: throttle applied, reduced to 20rps. monitor: p95 dropped ~160ms in the noisy shard but still 220ms overall.

dan-ramirez: flipping feature flag: `kernel.autoswitch=false` for pool prod-rt-1 (canary 2 nodes) -> then scale to all.

mike-chen: can you paste the rollback command in case things worsen?

dan-ramirez: rollback: `rbctl set pool prod-rt-1 kernel.autoswitch=true` (takes ~45s to propagate)

sarah-nguyen: also enabling fallback route for short-seq (<64) to cpu-quant via routing rule `route-length-short->cpu-quant`.

incident-bot: Action log: throttle tenant-42, feature flag flipped (canary->all), fallback route enabled.

leah-ops: perf probe after changes: p95 global now 120ms, p99 480ms. KV evictions down to 40/s. GPU mem growth stabilized.

mike-chen: flameprof shows kernel selection hotpath still hitting some paths where kernel chose slower matmul kernel for certain shapes. need a longer-term fix in kernel selector heuristics.

sarah-nguyen: agreed. short-term measures applied. next steps: dan to open a perf-issue with flameprof traces, mike to propose selector heuristic change, leah to add automated throttle rule for tenant burst patterns. I'll update incident ticket and notify customers if p95 stays low for 30m.

dan-ramirez: creating issue: PERF-3245 with traces + minimal repro. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml.

mike-chen: quick note: consider adding a fallback to older kernel version we verified stable for these models as a targeted mitigation while we change heuristics.

sarah-nguyen: agreed — add kernel version pin for tenant-42 in routing policy.

leah-ops: done: pinned tenant-42 to kernel `cuda-optim-v1-patch` for 1h.

incident-bot: Incident 'runtime-latency-spike' updated. Status: mitigated. Time to mitigate: 18m.

sarah-nguyen: thanks all. postmortem notes: root cause likely regressive kernel selection heuristics interacting with KV cache eviction pattern for hot tenants. Action owners: dan (perf issue), mike (selector heuristic PR), leah (auto-throttle rule), sarah (customer comms + postmortem). Closing thread if no objections.

mike-chen: no objections. good job.

dan-ramirez: thanks — will follow up with perf graphs.

leah-ops: closing action items in 24h.
